fields.name: fullName
fields.description: Full birth name to calculate Expression and Soul Urge numbers automatically. Use instead of passing expression and soulUrge directly.

fields.name: year
fields.description: Birth year to calculate Life Path automatically. Use with month and day instead of passing lifePath directly.

fields.name: month
fields.description: Birth month (1-12). Required with year and day for automatic Life Path calculation.

fields.name: day
fields.description: Birth day (1-31). Required with year and month for automatic Life Path calculation.

fields.name: lifePath
fields.description: Person 1 Life Path number (1-9, 11, 22, 33). Optional if year, month, day are provided.

fields.name: expression
fields.description: Person 1 Expression number (1-9, 11, 22, 33). Optional if fullName is provided.

fields.name: soulUrge
fields.description: Person 1 Soul Urge number (1-9, 11, 22, 33). Optional if fullName is provided.
